text:
Priya: Morning triage — 38 open tickets (+14 since midnight). Main hotspots: embeddings failures for DocuQ (500s) and a spike of webhook retries from the Stripe connector. I'm reviewing macros PR #842. Who can take coverage until 11:30 PST?
Eli: I can grab embeddings alerts. Will start looking at logs now — seeing repeated `embed-service 500` with upstream timeouts.
Marco: I'll look at the webhook path. If the new deploy caused regressions I'll roll back to v1.3.2. ETA ~20m.
support-bot: Alert: 14 new "embeddings-failed" events in last 10m. Top affected customer: DocuQ.
Tina: Macro tweak ready — it bumps ticket priority to `high` for webhook timeouts so we can triage faster. Snippet: ```/macro set priority=high condition=/webhook.*(500|timeout)/```
Priya: @Tina push to staging only for now. @Eli please validate the macro doesn't mask the root cause (don't auto-close).
Eli: Will validate on staging and run a replay: `./replay --customer DocuQ --since 2026-03-17T10:00Z`. If replay shows same failures I'll open an infra ticket.
Marco: Hotfix deployed to canary. Watching logs, no new 500s there for the last 3 minutes. Rolling to prod in 15m if stable.
Priya: Coverage plan: @Marco 10:00-12:00, @Eli 12:00-16:00, @Tina 09:00-13:00. I'll own escalations and billing-related tickets. Post here if you need a handoff.
Tina: Pushed macro to staging and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/842 — tests passing on staging.
Eli: Replay started. Early results: timeouts still at ~10:03 UTC and originate from model shard 3. Tagging eng-runtime for shard health (pinged them).
support-bot: Metric update: embedding error rate down 30% on canary since hotfix deployment.
Priya: Good. If errors persist after full replay, create INTERNAL-1123 (P1) and we escalate. For now, monitor dashboards and hold customer notifications. I'll update the macros doc and add a note not to auto-close.
Marco: Canary -> prod rollout completed, no obvious regression for webhook path.
Eli: Replay finished: 62% of failed events now succeed on canary config. I'll open follow-up with logs attached if we see more.
Tina: I'll add a short runbook entry about the macro and staging verification steps. PR link again: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/842
Priya: Thanks team — quick check: any remaining blockers?
Eli: None from my side, will stay on watch for two more hours. :thumbsup:
Marco: No blockers.
Tina: No blockers. Pushing runbook note in 10m.
support-bot: Incident note: embedding-alerts auto-resolved by canary rollback at 1765432234.
Priya: Closing this triage thread — will post a brief summary in the shift notes channel in 30m. If anything new pops up, reply here. :sparkles:
